title: A failed fix check counts as the next review round, inside the three-round cap
why: Owner, item 347 a, 13:12 CST Nov 7, after asking in chat at 13:07 CST whether resetting to round 1 was a good idea. Incident #1420 (the Windows fix), 13:03 CST.
note:
Coordinator pick, 13:37 CST Nov 7 (undoable): a failed fix check that counts as round 3 on a guard or check change owes the net-value test, written by a round-3 reviewer (Sonnet), not the Haiku fix check (decision hold-unsafe-after-round-3). Owner question item 356: does a round-3 FAIL hold the change?
Rewrite the last sentences of rule roles-review-cap-three (root CLAUDE.md): a failed fix check is the next round, not a new lane at round 1. If auto mode refuses the CLAUDE.md edit, the lane sends paste text and triage files an owner paste task. Done: the rule text on main, and the check that holds the rule (if any) red on the old reset, green on the new count. Coordinator picks, 14:15 CST Nov 7 (undoable), in #1440: a design reviewer's FAIL in round 3 holds the change, as a code reviewer's does (356 a names no reviewer kind). A fix check's FAIL after round 3 holds too. Folded in (coordinator 13:24 CST Nov 8, proposed step fix-check-needs-rounds): `merge --review-record --fix-check` with no `--round` prints a record that reads as open, and a lane (verdict-format-line, [ended:lane:-verdict-instruction-false-alarm]) posted four. Fix: the tool requires --round with --fix-check, or fills it. The fix-after-fix refusal it also hit is covered by #1957 (item 426 a). Sighting 2 (lane export-scan-key-false-alarms, #2372, 15:27 CST Nov 9): the same no-round fix-check record; the lane reposted it by hand. Folded from note fix-check-record-no-round. Ready, lane ended and not landed: root CLAUDE.md on origin/main still says a FAIL starts a new lane at round 1; #1440 and #1780 and #1957 closed unmerged; #2372 only a sighting (triage reader agent, Explore Sonnet audit, read of origin/main 0e6509a96, 06:03 CST Nov 10). Doing 06:06 CST Nov 10 in lane [ended:review-fix-check-round] (coordinator). Owner question from lane review-fix-check-round (#2545, draft), posted 09:42 CST Nov 10 as page item 485 (fresh-review-after-fail): after a failed round, does a fresh full review's pass still count as done? Item 347 a covers fix checks only, so no past ruling answers it. Frozen and handed off ( CST Nov 10, coordinator): PR #2545 head ec4967b06; handoff in the collector's store (archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10). Second owner question, to ask with item 485 when the step resumes: three Grant cases in merge/test_merge_grant.py expect a round-4 FAIL to read done or open; the test-author proposes re-pointing them to held. Owner ruling 10:50 CST Nov 10 (page item 485, none of these): "shouldnt they all read done after they are fixed?" Read as yes (coordinator 10:53 CST): after a failed round, a pass from a fresh full review or a passed fix check reads done, inside the three-round cap. This step is its home until the lane lands it in decision pr-review-record. Item 485 is closed; its Grant-case question still waits for the step to resume. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL2jTS37z97cavLKVTC.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10).
